review: Read complete protocol/selfcheck/report/manifest. Mandatory caller geometry, bounded whole-request grammar and finite resource limits. Supports6144/64K without hard-coded eight chunks, explicit LP5 expectation and bounded earlyEOS. Accepted drafts may exceed emitted after EOS; no invented proportional counters. Capacity uses physical_context minus actual batched_n, and full prompt can have one verifier position; exhausted_zero is hypothetical explicit caller expectation, not asserted binary behavior. No GPU completion, numerical parity, throughput adoption or full-context/global quality claim. CPU selfcheck and actual-capture qualification are Main owned and unexecuted.
